statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry)
The patient has recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack (ICD-10 G45.9)
The diagnosis codes submitted are I47.1 and G45.9
The denial reason code is PR-204
The service is clinically necessary to correlate palpitations and lightheadedness with transient neurological symptoms
The service is necessary to assess for potential embolic sources or hemodynamic instability
The claim was denied because the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
